Q: Error in .rs.exprMutatesPackageLibrary(expr) when adding paths to a data.table A:

According to this RStudio GitHub ticket, this appears to be a known bug.

The issue is apparently fixed in the newest daily build. If that's correct, you can either upgrade to the latest daily build, downgrade to the previous version, or put up with it until the fix makes it into the official version.

EDIT: It's fixed in the latest official release now too.

Q: Why aren't credentials/regions from any profile other than default being loaded? A:

It's a bug in the AWS SDK for Java!

The fix was committed literally yesterday lol (August 5, 2026).

Here is the issue -- https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-java-v2/issues/7196

Here is the fix -- https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-java-v2/pull/7217

So, the fixed version is 2.51.1.

Here are the release notes for 2.51.1 -- https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-java-v2/releases/tag/2.51.1

Ctrl+F "AWS Sign-In Service" to jump right to confirmation about the fix being included.

Q: Cannot find module: internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:969 A:

Try opening your file again from the original folder. I had the same issue now it's fixed, after changing the location.

Q: Authenticate with Windows Credentials in Python A:

The following worked for me when connecting to sharepoint using requests_negotiate_sspi:

import requests
from requests_negotiate_sspi import HttpNegotiateAuth

proxies = {'https': "https://user:password@proxyIP:port"}
response = requests.get('www.google.com', proxies=proxies, auth = HttpNegotiateAuth())
